policy_change: User requested ignoring average waiting-count growth and first scanning the boundary/maximum observed throughput.

retained_gates.other_checks: Valid offered load, service/container identity, telemetry coverage, OOM, resource growth and complete drain remain enforced.

queue_reporting: Queue histories, means, peaks, queue_changes and queue_stable remain recorded. queue_stability_required explicitly distinguishes the revised decision policy.

search_reference.original_failure: Average worker waiting growth exceeded the experimental threshold; all other stage gates passed.
search_reference.scope: Historical reinterpretation only. The scan does not import this lower bracket after musa-97-1 recovery changed its PID. Original data remain unchanged; a configured search_reference in future runs still requires exact comparability.

scan.interpretation: Highest passing measured point and peak measured Goodput are short-duration observations, not validated long-term system capacity or an absolute hardware maximum.

healthy_scope.scope_changed: Do not combine with previous 29-worker capacity data.

covered: Queue observation mode cannot bypass success/SLO/resource/offered-load gates
Reference stage is reinterpreted without changing source artifacts
Reference workload/SLO or process-identity mismatch is rejected
A scan retains failing overload points, continues to later rates, records peak Goodput and does not run long stability phases

reproduction: Existing system_benchmark.json and benchmark.py --system-config entry; per-run source, workload, preflight and process snapshots preserve the exact decision policy and healthy worker set.
maintenance: Existing code, runtime, containers, services and metrics reused. No extra monitoring automation. Stabilized the real HAProxy burst test by reusing its thread-safe HTTPX client rather than repeatedly constructing clients inside the one-second queue deadline. Temporary test servers/processes are cleaned up by their fixtures.

preflight_incident.action: Restart briefly restored correct answers, but a single 256/1024 long-output request reproduced corruption. Stopped and quarantined only musa-97-1 in its original container; did not modify other model settings.
preflight_incident.root_cause: Undetermined. Reproduction establishes recurrence after long output on this worker; it does not establish a hardware fault.

recovery_probe.other_workers_check: Each worker produced 1024 output tokens and answered 2+3 correctly before and after.
